title: loxogramme malayana
intro: Loxogramme malayana, commonly known as Malay fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Loxogramme malayana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
